items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: I was going to ask: with Hamp – because you were a visionary with this already, but I guess it was – what was happening with Hampton . . .
If you say so – with Hampton made this so necessary, because with Fox Walker and Sonny Johnson – I had been told that a lot of this was because they had to have something that could match the volume.
